Quick Add now recognizes and highlights Todoist-style shortcuts as you type. Both task editors, task lists, menus, and settings use your desktop's proportional UI font.

![Quick Add recognizes dates, priorities, projects, and labels](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omatasks/v1.2.0/screenshots/quick-add.png)

## New

- **Live Quick Add recognition in both editors.** Common English dates, times, and repeat schedules update the date chip automatically. Projects, sections, labels, priorities (`p1` or `!!1`), assignees, reminders, deadlines, and durations on timed tasks are recognized as you type or paste. Dates and priorities use Todoist-style highlight colors. By @crmne.
- **Proportional panel typography.** Task lists, both editors, menus, tooltips, and settings follow the desktop's native UI font, without a separate font picker. By @crmne.

![Task panel with proportional text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omatasks/v1.2.0/screenshots/today.png)

## Fixed

- **Long task names wrap.** Recognized shortcuts stay highlighted across wrapped lines; changing a chip updates the corresponding typed shortcut without duplicating it when submitted. An explicit date or `no date` overrides the Today editor's default schedule. By @crmne.
- **Transient sync failures retry automatically.** Cached tasks stay visible while refresh retries back off from five seconds to five minutes. **Retry now** starts another attempt immediately, while respecting Todoist rate limits. By @crmne; thanks @keegan-sucks for the connection-failure report in [#2](https://github.com/crmne/omatasks/issues/2).

## Known limitations

- Live date previews recognize common English expressions. Other expressions and account languages are sent unchanged to Todoist's official Quick Add parser when saved.
- Automatic retries do not replace Qt's cached HTTP/2 connection. Persistent connection failures after network changes remain under investigation in [#2](https://github.com/crmne/omatasks/issues/2).

## Validation

70 JavaScript tests, 17 composer UI checks, and 18 list interaction checks passed. QML parsing, shell syntax checks, and Omarchy plugin validation also passed. Screenshots use synthetic tasks rendered from the real QML components on the NVIDIA GPU. API tests intercept requests without accessing a Todoist account.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omatasks.git --enable
```

Requires Omarchy Quattro and a Todoist account. Existing users can update the plugin through Omarchy.

## Thanks

Thanks to @crmne for implementation and @keegan-sucks for reporting the connection failure.

OmaTasks is an independent project, not created by, affiliated with, or supported by Todoist.
